School Sphere
Administrator guide

Registering new joinees,
teachers and students

A step-by-step walk-through of onboarding a new staff member from Human Resources and enrolling a student from Student Management, with the screens exactly as you will see them.

1 · New joinee / teacherHuman Resources › Staff Management › New joining
2 · New studentAcademics › Students › Register student
Overview

What you will do

School Sphere has one place for each kind of person. Staff and teachers are registered in Human Resources; students are registered in Academics › Students. Both take about two minutes and automatically prepare the sign-in for the person, so no separate "create user" step is needed.

New joinee or teacher Menu: Human Resources › Staff Management
Button: New joining
Teachers are staff members whose designation is Teacher. They then appear automatically under Academics › Teachers for class and subject assignment.
New student Menu: Academics › Students
Button: Register student
Enrols the student straight into a class and section and records the guardian. Students who are still applying use the Admissions tab instead.

Before you start

For a new joinee
  • Full name, date of birth, gender
  • Designation (Teacher, Accountant, Librarian, …)
  • Department the person belongs to
  • A mobile number and/or email address
  • Residential address
For a new student
  • Full name, date of birth, gender
  • Class and section already created for the branch
  • Residential address
  • Guardian name, relation and mobile number
  • Optional: student email, parent email

Signing in

Open the school's School Sphere address and sign in with your administrator account (email and password, or an OTP if your school has enabled it). Staff and student registration is available to Administrators and Principals.

Part 1

Register a new joinee or teacher (Human Resources)

1 · Open Staff Management

In the left menu choose Human Resources. The Staff Management page lists every staff member with their designation, department, status and Login account state. Select the green New joining button at the top right.

2 · Fill in the New joining panel

12345678
  1. 1
    Branch: the campus the person will work at. It is pre-selected for single-campus schools.
  2. 2
    First name and Last name.
  3. 3
    Date of birth and Gender.
  4. 4
    Designation / Role: choose Teacher for a teacher (or Principal, Accountant, Librarian, Receptionist, …). Then pick the Department.
  5. 5
    Reporting person: who approves this person's profile changes. The default, Department head (suggested), is right for most joinees.
  6. 6
    Mobile number and Email: these create the sign-in (see next page).
  7. 7
    Address: required.
  8. 8
    Select Add staff member. The message “Staff member added” confirms it.
School Sphere · Registration guide: new joinees, teachers and studentsPage 3
Part 1 · continued

After saving: the new joinee is ready

What happens automatically
  • An employee ID is generated (EMP-xxxx).
  • The status is set to Active with today as the joining date.
  • A staff login is created and linked, so the column shows Account linked.
  • With an email: an invitation is sent to set a password. With a mobile number: the person can sign in with a one-time code. With neither: no login is created, and it can be linked later.
Teachers A joinee registered with the designation Teacher also appears under Academics › Teachers, where you assign subjects and classes. Until assigned, Subjects and Classes show 0.

Check or manage the login

Select the staff member's name to open the profile. The tabs hold Overview, Qualifications & Experience, Salary, Attendance, Performance and Documents.

The Login tab (administrators) shows the linked sign-in. Unlink separates it if the wrong account was linked. Records created without an email or mobile number can be linked here later.

School Sphere · Registration guide: new joinees, teachers and studentsPage 4
Part 2

Register a new student (Student Management)

1 · Open Students

From the left menu choose Academics; the Students tab opens first. The page lists each student with class, roll number, status, guardian and Login account state. Select Register student at the top right.

2 · Fill in the Register student panel

123456789
  1. 1
    Branch: the campus where the student is enrolled.
  2. 2
    First name and Last name.
  3. 3
    Date of birth and Gender.
  4. 4
    Class, then Section, and an optional Roll number. Classes and sections come from Academic Setup.
  5. 5
    Address: required.
  6. 6
    Guardian name, Relation (father, mother or guardian) and Guardian mobile.
  7. 7
    Student email / Student mobile (optional): creates the student's own sign-in.
  8. 8
    Parent email (optional): creates the parent sign-in for the Parent Portal and app.
  9. 9
    Select Register student. The message “Student registered” confirms it.
School Sphere · Registration guide: new joinees, teachers and studentsPage 5
Part 2 · continued

After saving: the student is on the roll

What happens automatically
  • An admission number is generated (EDU-year-number).
  • The student is placed in the chosen class and section with status Active.
  • The guardian is saved against the student.
  • Each email gives a login: student email → student login, parent email → parent login, both linked, with an invitation to set a password. A mobile number signs in with a one-time code.
  • If the parent already has a login (a brother or sister is enrolled), the new student is linked to it instead of creating a second one.
Open the student record Select the student's name for a quick view: admission number, roll number, date of birth, admission date and address, plus Guardians and Health tabs. Open full profile shows everything, and Edit changes details later.

Other ways to add students

MethodWhen to use it
Admissions tabThe child is applying. Track enquiry → exam → interview → fee → decision, then register.
Import buttonEnrolling many students at once from a prepared file.

Quick reference

Field checklist and tips

New joining (staff / teacher)

FieldRequiredNotes
BranchYesPre-selected when the school has one campus.
First name, Last nameYes
Date of birth, GenderYesMale, Female or Other.
Designation / RoleYesTeacher, Principal, Accountant, Librarian, Receptionist and other roles your school defines.
DepartmentSelect oneChoose the person's department. Departments are maintained by your administrator.
Reporting personOptionalReceives the joinee's profile-change requests for approval. With none, they go to the school administrators.
Mobile number, EmailOptionalAt least one is needed to create a sign-in.
AddressYes

Register student

FieldRequiredNotes
BranchYes
First name, Last nameYes
Date of birth, GenderYes
Class, SectionYesThe class and section must already exist for the branch.
Roll numberOptionalLeave blank if you do not use roll numbers.
AddressYes
Guardian name, Relation, Guardian mobileYesRelation: father, mother or guardian.
Student email / mobile, Parent emailOptionalEach one creates a sign-in. Leave blank to create logins later.
Good to know
  • Leave email and mobile blank when you do not want a login yet. You can link one later from the profile's Login tab.
  • Red messages under a field tell you what is missing; the panel will not save until they clear.
  • If a name, email or mobile already has a login, the screen tells you rather than creating a duplicate.
Also from the Staff screen
  • Promote: change designation with an effective date
  • Record resignation / Reactivate
  • Import: bulk onboarding from a file
  • Leave Requests tab: staff leave approvals
